title: PH v0.5 Access-Relative Tri-Horizon Falsification

frozen_prior.PH_v0.3.3_r1: single shared-boundary node identity NON_IDENTIFIABLE under A0
frozen_prior.PH_v0.5_P0_r1: static freeze staged but not Human-PI approved; superseded by P0-r2 debug hardening before any P1 implementation

primary_objective: PHを固定境界ではなく、H_V・H_O・H_Iからなるアクセス相対的・履歴依存的因果地平として操作化し、三地平の分離可能性、アクセス相対性、H_Iの非冗長性、履歴効果、最小識別アクセス条件を合成系で反証する。

research_questions.RQ1: H_V,H_O,H_Iは単一自由度へ縮約可能か。
research_questions.RQ2: 基礎力学固定でアクセスaだけを変えるとH_Oは変化するか。
research_questions.RQ3: H_IはH_V/H_Oに対して未知介入予測の追加情報を持つか。
research_questions.RQ4: 観測状態を一致させても履歴差が将来応答へ残るか。
research_questions.RQ5: A0で同値なshared modelとoracle cloneを、モデル非依存な追加アクセスで区別できるか。

hypotheses.H3: non-redundancy of H_I under a frozen balanced heterogeneity lattice
hypotheses.H4: history dependence under matched observed state
hypotheses.H5: enriched access breaks A0 oracle equivalence

debug_hardening: Common-random-number seed derivation no longer includes generator/access in paired plant substreams.
A0 pulse/multisine/PRBS timing is fully fixed and PRBS is deterministic.
H3 chirp uses local time tau=t-20 rather than absolute time.
H3 feature and target stochastic streams are independent to prevent shared-noise leakage.
H3 uses a balanced, frozen three-axis heterogeneity lattice so non-redundancy is estimable rather than being driven only by seed noise.
H4 permutation test is fully specified.
Q8 is an explicit null-canary suite rather than an undefined family-wise false-positive estimate.
Static CI now audits cross-file invariants, seed-range disjointness and execution locks.

phases.P1: deterministic implementation, prohibited until Human PI freeze approval
phases.P2: qualification, prohibited until P1 deterministic audit PASS
phases.P3: fresh Pilot, prohibited until P2 all mandatory gates PASS
phases.P4: Confirmatory, explicit Human PI authorization required

critical_policy: No seed extension after seeing results.
No model-specific latent-node names may be used by A2.
A0 oracle equivalence must be analytic by construction and numerically replayed; failure-to-reject is not equivalence.
G7/G8/G9 freeze parameter perturbations, not desired outcomes.
Paired plant streams use pair_group; measurement and H3-target streams are separate.
Any mandatory Qualification gate FAIL => STOP.
No biological, human, consciousness, qualia, soul, or real-world existence claim.
